si3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2021
si4_title: Atypical Brain Asymmetry in Autism -A Candidate for Clinically Meaningful Stratification

dc1_datasets_used_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized the EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) as the primary discovery dataset and the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and II as the replication dataset.
dc1_datasets_used_in_this_study.supporting_text: we used the large EU-AIMS (European Autism Interventions -A Multicentre Study for Developing New Medications) Longitudinal European Autism Project dataset ... as well as a replication dataset from ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) (513 individuals with autism, 691 neurotypical subjects)

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: LEAP was used for training the voxel-wise normative model of gray matter laterality and for primary clinical stratfication and association analyses. ABIDE served as an independent replication dataset to confirm the presence of individualized extreme deviations in autism.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: we leveraged the EU-AIMS ... LEAP ... as well as a replication dataset from ABIDE ... to examine extreme right- and leftward deviations in an independent dataset.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: ABSTRACT, METHODS AND MATERIALS / Robustness and Replicability

dc3_hc_n_each_normative_model.detail: The LEAP normative model was trained on 233 neurotypical controls (154 male, 79 female). The ABIDE replication model was trained on 691 neurotypical subjects (473 male, 218 female). For both datasets, the normative model was trained on the respective neurotypical cohort.
dc3_hc_n_each_normative_model.supporting_text: 233 neurotypical control subjects (154 male and 79 female) ... a replication dataset from ABIDE (513 individuals with autism, 691 neurotypical subjects)
dc3_hc_n_each_normative_model.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Participants; Floris2021_sup.pdf.md: Replication sample ABIDE I and II

dc4_age_info_each_normative_model.detail: Age statistics for LEAP NT were derived from Table 1 (Male: 17.1 [5.9], 7.4-30.9; Female: 16.4 [5.8], 6.9-28.5). Age statistics for ABIDE NT were derived from Table S2 (Male: 12.7 [4.2], 7.1-29.0; Female: 12.5 [4.7], 7.0-29.9). Weighted means and pooled SDs were calculated to combine male and female statistics.

dc5_sex_info_each_normative_model.detail: The LEAP neurotypical cohort consisted of 154 males and 79 females. The ABIDE neurotypical cohort used for replication consisted of 473 males and 218 females.
dc5_sex_info_each_normative_model.supporting_text: 233 neurotypical control subjects (154 male and 79 female) ... resulted in a sample of ... 473 neurotypical males and 218 neurotypical females.
